i'm unemployed, broke, waiting to move to another state to finish my bachelors, assuming they accept my transfer. i live in an area that is miserably hot until maybe 5-6pm and everything is entirely car-centric. if i wanted to go anywhere except a touristy junk shop, i need a car. i don't have access to a car unless i plan around it. i don't have money for new hobbies. my only friend is busy all the time and broke too.

i hate reading recently. it's very boring. but so is the constant scrolling, and that feels worse. i used to draw a lot, but i have little motivation anymore because it isn't fun. maybe i am a bit depressed but i can't be back on my medication until i do my sleep study (whole other side thing.) i used to play video games a lot but ive played everything i have as much as interests me and now im just stuck.

im seeing instagram reels in my sleep and i cant fucking stand it but what else do i do. im going to try to clean today but once thats done, what else? i only have tiny other things i can do and the rest of my hours are just absorbed by napping or staring at my phone and i feel more hopeless about being alive than ever. nothing i CAN do is any fun or interesting to me. "going outside" from where i live means just concrete and people and sweating to death unless i can drive to a nicer place. i feel evil
